name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta province, Argentina. A completed definitive feasibility study projects an after-tax NPV of approximately $3 billion USD and a 42% IRR with a 1.7-year payback period. The company is targeting early construction works in mid-2026 and first production by end of 2029, subject to a final investment decision expected in Q2 2027.
